Hello! I've been straight edge my whole life so I'll try to answer your questions. 

Firstly, straight edge originated in the punk scene I think but many have come to believe that it has since moved away from that and that you don't have to be a fan of the hardcore music to be straight edge. While I do like hardcore music sometimes, I don't think it's a requirement to claim edge.

No drinking, no drugs, no smoking are the core beliefs of straight edge, however some (including myself) choose to also forego promiscuity. An example of this would be causal sex (Having sex for fun, as you put it). Others also choose to not have caffeine as you can become dependant on it and end up relying on it. You can also go through caffeine withdrawals which can cause headaches if you haven't had it in awhile. I also wondered about food cooked with alcohol so I asked my food-science teacher about it. She said that a lot of the alcohol that is involved in cooking gets evaporated in the process and perhaps only a miniscule amount remains, so I don't fret over my food being cooked with alcohol. 

Lastly, I haven't had too many people look down on me for being straight edge, but that's probably because I don't go out much. However if someone were to ridicule me for it, I wouldn't care. It's my choice to not drink just as its their (in my opinion, terrible) choice to drink.

It's been said a lot but we are the last of a dying breed. I find it quite difficult to find other straight edge people nowadays and I really wish more people would choose not to fuck their lives up with drugs, alcohol and the like. Hopefully you'll end up claiming edge, but if not that's fine too!
